name: Demo Filer
narrative: Final-year student who did a 6-month internship (Oct 2025-Mar 2026) at a startup, paid Rs 25,000/month stipend with 10% TDS deducted under section 194J (professional fees) because the company treated the intern as a consultant rather than an employee. No Form 16 was issued (only 26AS/AIS). Refund is due either way, but the correct ITR form is genuinely debatable.
